# Arthur Sabintsev

> Physicist, engineer, and two-time founder. Co-founder of Grove, the team behind Pocket Network. Took the POKT token past a $1B+ market cap. Contact: arthur.sabintsev@gmail.com.

## About
Arthur Ariel Sabintsev is a physicist turned engineer turned founder (Washington DC–Baltimore). He co-founded [Grove](https://grove.city), the team behind [Pocket Network](https://pocket.network), and helped take its token (POKT) past a $1B+ market cap. Earlier: experimental nuclear physics at Jefferson Lab and GW; iOS engineering; mobile leadership at ID.me, the Washington Post (Arc XP), and Capital One. Writes on AI agents, stablecoins, and operator craft on [Substack](https://artsabintsev.substack.com).
